headline: Pricing gains and cost discipline drive a sharp profit jump
summary_short: MSC Industrial's quarter ended May 30, 2026 saw net sales rise 7.8% y/y to $1,047.1M, gross margin tick up to 41.1% from 41.0%, and net income attributable to MSC Industrial jump 41.4% to $80.4M as diluted EPS climbed to $1.44 from $1.02.
summary_long: Net sales rose 7.8% y/y to $1,047.1M on $70.1M of favorable pricing, $4.5M higher volume, and $1.3M FX benefit; national account and public sector sales also grew. Gross margin ticked up to 41.1% on favorable pricing actions. Operating expenses grew a slower 3.6%, falling to 30.9% of sales from 32.2%, lifting operating income 29.0% to $106.7M. A $5.1M Employee Retention Credit benefit cut Total other expense 67.2% to $2.5M. Net income attributable to MSC Industrial rose 41.4% to $80.4M; diluted EPS climbed to $1.44 from $1.02. Cash stood at $74.1M; total debt was $506.8M. No numeric forward guidance appears in this 10-Q. YTD capex ran $64.1M; the company declared a $0.87/share dividend this quarter.
